info.title: OpenProtein Prompt
info.description: # Prompt API The Prompt API provided by OpenProtein.ai allows you to construct and upload prompts to use with our PoET models.

401.description: Bad or expired token. This can happen if the token is revoked or expired. User should re-authenticate with their credentials.

context.title: Context
context.description: A list of zip files, where the i'th file specifies the data for the i'th context in the prompt. Each zip file may contain:   - fasta files containing lists of sequences   - cif structure files The file extensions of the zipped files have to match.

project_uuid.title: Project Uuid
project_uuid.description: Optional project UUID to attach the prompt to.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional. Prompt metadata as a JSON object, e.g. {"multichain": true}. Sent as a JSON-encoded string in this multipart form; shape is not validated.

query.title: Query
query.description: A file specifying the query. The file may be a specify a sequence (fasta) or a structure (cif). The file extension have to match.

project_uuid.title: Project Uuid
project_uuid.description: Optional project UUID to attach the query to.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: A error object providing details of the error.

created_date.title: Created Date
created_date.description: The date the prompt was created.

num_replicates.title: Num Replicates
num_replicates.description: Number of replicates provided as context.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Job ID of any associated job for the prompt.

project_uuid.title: Project Uuid
project_uuid.description: Project this prompt is attached to.

is_system.title: Is System
is_system.description: True for platform-curated system prompts available to every user. System prompts are read-only over the HTTP API; users cannot create, modify, or delete them. False or absent for user-uploaded prompts.

sequence_length.title: Sequence Length
sequence_length.description: Length of the prompt's context chains. Set when every chain across every Complex across every replicate has the same length; null when chain lengths vary or no context has been parsed yet.

models.title: Models
models.description: Curated, options-validated list of model slugs this prompt claims compatibility with.

proteins.title: Proteins
proteins.description: Curated, options-validated list of protein-class descriptors. Empty means "uncategorized" and does not match a ``protein=...`` filter.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-form JSON object of prompt metadata (e.g. allows_query, multichain, multichain_mode). Shape is not validated by the service.

prompt_type.title: Prompt Type
prompt_type.description: Free-form text classifier for the prompt — no service-side vocab. Curators and clients can use this to group prompts in the UI (e.g. "inverse-folding", "design"). Null = unset.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about normalizations applied to the uploaded sequences during creation (e.g. gap characters removed, residues uppercased). Empty for prompts retrieved after creation.

PromptMetadata.title: PromptMetadata
PromptMetadata.description: The metadata of a prompt entity containing sequences and/or structures as context and an optional query used to condition PoET models.

project_uuid.title: Project Uuid
project_uuid.description: Project to attach the prompt to.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Replace the prompt's tags with this JSON object. Shape is not validated by the service.

PromptUpdate.title: PromptUpdate
PromptUpdate.description: Fields to update on a prompt. Omitted fields are left unchanged; fields provided with an explicit null value (for nullable fields) are cleared.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the query. Defaults to the query's UUID string when the user has not set a name explicitly; clearing the name via PUT (passing `null` to `QueryUpdate.name`) resets it to this default.

created_date.title: Created Date
created_date.description: The date the query was created.

project_uuid.title: Project Uuid
project_uuid.description: Project this query is attached to.

sequence_length.title: Sequence Length
sequence_length.description: Length of the query's protein chain(s). Set when every chain in the query has the same length; null when chains differ in length.

QueryMetadata.title: QueryMetadata
QueryMetadata.description: The metadata of a query entity containing the sequence and/or structure used as a query to condition PoET2 models.

project_uuid.title: Project Uuid
project_uuid.description: Project to attach the query to.

QueryUpdate.title: QueryUpdate
QueryUpdate.description: Fields to update on a query. Omitted fields are left unchanged; fields provided with an explicit null value (for nullable fields) are cleared.
